item.title: U Mobile Partners with OpenAI in Bid to Become Malaysia’s First AI-Enabled Telco
item.summary: U Mobile has entered into a strategic collaboration with OpenAI to embed artificial intelligence (AI) across its operations, customer services, enterprise offerings, and cybersecurity, supporting the Malaysian operator’s ambition to become the country’s first AI-enabled telco. The collaboration will combine U Mobile’s 5G network with OpenAI’s AI capabilities.
